instructions: Class assignment 1 (Modules 1 to 3), set by the BT faculty.
Marks are not printed on the sheet; each answer is written at the length of a 10-mark exam answer, and short notes and lists at 5 marks.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: Define blockchain and explain its key characteristics (e.g., immutability, transparency, decentralization).

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: Describe distributed ledger? Explain its importance in blockchain technology.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: Illustrate the need for private blockchains.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: Compare the three types of blockchains: Public, Private, and Consortium.

questions.label: 1e
questions.text: Differentiate between centralized, decentralized, and distributed systems.

questions.label: 1f
questions.text: Discuss the role of blockchain in eliminating intermediaries.

questions.label: 1g
questions.text: Define Merkle tree? Explain structure of merkle tree.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text: State Proof of Work (PoW) and Proof of Stake (PoS) consensus mechanisms.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text: Define mining in Bitcoin? Describe the mining process and mining difficulty adjustment.

questions.label: 2c
questions.text: With a suitable diagram, explain the structure of a Bitcoin block header.

questions.label: 2d
questions.text: Differentiate between Bitcoin's UTXO model and Ethereum's account model.

questions.label: 2e
questions.text: What is a Bitcoin script? Explain Pay-to-Public-Key-Hash (P2PKH) with an example.

questions.label: 2f
questions.text: Compare Bitcoin's security features with traditional financial systems.

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Describe the architecture of Ethereum and its components (e.g., EVM, accounts, gas).

questions.label: 3b
questions.text: Explain the difference between ERC20 and ERC721 token standards with examples.

questions.label: 3c
questions.text: State the different types of accounts in Ethereum? Explain their uses.

questions.label: 3d
questions.text: Discuss the advantages of Ethereum smart contracts compared to traditional contracts.

questions.label: 3e
questions.text: Compare Ethereum with Bitcoin in terms of functionality and use cases.
